notes: Van Horne is printed 'VAN HORNE' (20'); it runs from x~1548 east to Laurel Alley and stops there (the block east of Laurel is continuous to Freeman). West of x~1548 it continues only as an unnamed 8 ft alley along its south side to Carr. Laurel Alley (11') runs 8th to 7th; sheet 49 shows the block north of 8th unbroken, so it is a T at 8th. Zachary is printed 'ZACHARY (TAYLOR)'. Budd and the west side of Carr are context only (sheet 36 area); Budd ends at Carr. Barr and Kenyon Avenue start at Freeman and run east onto sheet 38. Freeman crosses the rail yard on an iron bridge between Kenyon and Zachary (no intersections there). West 8th: only the south face is on the sheet (y~300-305); centre computed for the 60 ft width at y~200, just inside the paper edge (y~190). West 6th is labelled 66; only the north face is on the sheet (y~4391-4407) and the centre is computed 111 px south of it. Carr runs very slightly off vertical (x 1133 at 8th to 1150 at 6th). Carr and Freeman continue south of 6th on sheet 18.
